Package paint.viewer.model

Class RecordingEntry

java.lang.Object
paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry
public class RecordingEntry extends Object
Viewer-level wrapper for a Recording containing all metadata and preloaded image resources for a single experiment recording.

This entry supplies:

  • TrackMate overlay image (left display)
  • Brightfield image (right display)
  • Delegated metadata access (probe, adjuvant, concentration, density, etc.)
  • Access to the full Recording for retrieving squares

The entry is immutable after construction. All square-level access and data manipulation occur on the underlying Recording instance.
